annotations.title: What is the size of this audience profile?

description: Use when the user is defining or sizing a consumer audience or checking a TAM claim: "how many college-educated 25-34 year olds are in the US?", "how many homeowner households in Texas earn over $150,000?". Counts people or households matching a profile from the 2024 ACS microdata, with a 90% margin of error and the share of the area. No filters on race, ethnicity, religion or disability. Refuses before you are charged if the weights do not reproduce the published population or the sample is too thin. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one release (ACS 2024); place: state or pumas; segment: age, sex, income, education, employed, tenure, children, occupations. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For where that audience lives, use run_audience_map; for what it spends, use run_wallet_size.
